blocks.html: The details of the cart to refresh the promotion adjustments for.

types.name: cart
types.description: The cart, if already retrieved. If not provided, the cart is retrieved by its ID.

types.name: promo_codes
types.description: The promotion codes to apply to the cart. They replace the cart's existing promotions.

types.name: additional_promotion_context
types.description: Custom context merged on top of the cart context when evaluating promotion rules.
